CREATE TABLE game_configuration(singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1) REFERENCES game_record(singleton),numeric_upper_bound INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(numeric_upper_bound BETWEEN 1 AND 1000),board_side_length INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(board_side_length BETWEEN 2 AND 10),free_cells_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(free_cells_enabled IN (0,1)),player_capacity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(player_capacity BETWEEN 2 AND 20),spectator_capacity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(spectator_capacity BETWEEN 0 AND 50),winning_pattern TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT
CREATE TABLE game_free_cells(row INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(row BETWEEN 1 AND 10),column INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(column BETWEEN 1 AND 10),PRIMARY KEY(row,column)) STRICT

CREATE TABLE game_history(game_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES game_record(game_id),game_code TEXT NOT NULL,designated_host_id TEXT NOT NULL,started_at INTEGER CHECK(started_at IS NULL OR started_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991) NOT NULL CHECK(started_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991),ended_at INTEGER CHECK(ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991) NOT NULL CHECK(ended_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991),expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(expires_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991) CHECK(expires_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991),outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(outcome IN ('resolved','cancelled')),winner_player_id TEXT,winner_alias TEXT,CHECK(expires_at>ended_at),CHECK((outcome='resolved' AND winner_player_id IS NOT NULL AND winner_alias IS NOT NULL) OR (outcome='cancelled' AND winner_player_id IS NULL AND winner_alias IS NULL))) STRICT

CREATE TABLE game_history_board_cells(game_id TEXT NOT NULL,player_id TEXT NOT NULL,row INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(row BETWEEN 1 AND 10),column INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(column BETWEEN 1 AND 10),kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('free','value')),value TEXT,is_matched INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(is_matched IN (0,1)),PRIMARY KEY(game_id,player_id,row,column),FOREIGN KEY(game_id,player_id) REFERENCES game_history_players(game_id,player_id)) STRICT

CREATE TABLE game_history_calls(game_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES game_history(game_id),sequence_no INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(sequence_no BETWEEN 1 AND 1000),value TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(game_id,sequence_no),UNIQUE(game_id,value)) STRICT

CREATE TABLE game_history_players(game_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES game_history(game_id),player_id TEXT NOT NULL,alias TEXT NOT NULL,side_length INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(side_length BETWEEN 2 AND 10),PRIMARY KEY(game_id,player_id)) STRICT

CREATE TABLE game_players(player_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,alias TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE BINARY UNIQUE CHECK(length(CAST(alias AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 20),joined_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(joined_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991),session_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(session_epoch BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991) CHECK(session_epoch BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991),last_explicit_leave_at INTEGER CHECK(last_explicit_leave_at IS NULL OR last_explicit_leave_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)) STRICT

CREATE TABLE game_recovery(player_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES game_players(player_id),answer_verifier TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(answer_verifier)<=256),normalization_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(normalization_version=1),updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(updated_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)) STRICT

CREATE TABLE game_sessions(session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,token_verifier BLOB NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(token_verifier)=32),game_id TEXT NOT NULL,game_code TEXT NOT NULL,player_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES game_players(player_id),session_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(session_epoch BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991) CHECK(session_epoch>=0),access TEXT NOT NULL,issued_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(issued_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991),expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(expires_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991) CHECK(expires_at>issued_at),revoked_at INTEGER CHECK(revoked_at IS NULL OR revoked_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)) STRICT

CREATE TABLE game_terminal_route(singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),game_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,host_id TEXT NOT NULL,fingerprint BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(fingerprint)=32),state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('resolved','cancelled')),revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991),game_code TEXT NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(created_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991) CHECK(created_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991),started_at INTEGER CHECK(started_at IS NULL OR started_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991) NOT NULL CHECK(started_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991),ended_at INTEGER CHECK(ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991) NOT NULL CHECK(ended_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991),history_expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(history_expires_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991),CHECK(created_at<=started_at AND started_at<=ended_at AND ended_at<history_expires_at)) STRICT

CREATE TABLE game_terminal_views(session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,player_id TEXT NOT NULL,token_verifier BLOB NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(token_verifier)=32),session_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(session_epoch BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991) CHECK(session_epoch BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991),expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(expires_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991) CHECK(expires_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991)) STRICT

CREATE TABLE game_boards(player_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES game_players(player_id),side_length INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(side_length BETWEEN 2 AND 10),assigned_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(assigned_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991),evaluated_through_call INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(evaluated_through_call BETWEEN 0 AND 1000)) STRICT
